description: Answers "Are Nvidia's executives selling?", "Did any Intel insider buy shares on the open market this year?" or "What did Tesla's CFO do with his vested stock?". Returns a US public company's latest Form 4 filings from SEC EDGAR, the reports officers, directors and 10% owners must file within two business days of trading its stock: who traded (name, role, title), each transaction with its date, code and plain-English meaning, shares, price, dollar value, holdings after, and direct or indirect ownership, plus footnotes. A summary totals open-market purchases and sales (shares, dollars, which insiders) and separates sales under pre-arranged Rule 10b5-1 plans and sales that only cover taxes on vesting stock, which say little about insiders' views. Filter by filing date or transaction code (e.g. ["P"] for open-market purchases), optionally with option and RSU transactions; up to 40 filings per call. By ticker, CIK or company name. If nothing matches you get 404, free. You are only charged when a result is returned: invalid input (400) and upstream failures (4xx/5xx) are not settled. Costs $0.005 USDC per call via x402. Paid per call with x402 inside MCP (see the server instructions).

cik.description: SEC Central Index Key, e.g. 320193. Use this, `ticker` or `company`.

company.description: Company name, e.g. "Apple" or "Coca-Cola". Use this, `ticker` or `cik`; a name matching several companies returns their tickers, free.

include_derivative.description: Also list derivative transactions (option and RSU grants, exercises, expirations). Default false.

limit.description: How many Form 4 filings to return, newest first (1-40, default 15).

since.description: Only filings filed on or after this date (YYYY-MM-DD).

ticker.description: US stock ticker, e.g. AAPL, MSFT, BRK-B. Use this, `cik` or `company`.

transaction_codes.description: Only filings with these transaction codes, e.g. ["P"] for open-market purchases, ["P", "S"] for open-market buying and selling. Default: all filings.

via.description: Optional: the tool whose next_calls suggested this call (filled in for you).

name: sec_insider_trades
title: SEC Form 4 insider trades
